s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with optic disc swelling and retinal vascular occlusion in a patient undergoing immunotherapy
salient_findings: Sudden vision loss in the right eye
Marked swelling of the optic disc
Peripapillary retinal hemorrhages and occlusion of the superior branch artery
Combined occlusion of the central retinal artery and vein
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 40s
Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab
Initial visual acuity of 20/25 OU
Right eye showed full visual field and relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild swelling of the optic disc on initial examination
Vision loss occurred 10 days after initial presentation
MRI showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve
Lumbar puncture showed no abnormalities
Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm
Immunohistochemistry positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein

trace.fact: Sudden vision loss in the right eye

rule_in.why: it is most directly associated with sudden vision loss

rule_out.why: it is less commonly associated with sudden unilateral vision loss

trace.fact: Marked swelling of the optic disc

rule_in.why: it is most closely associated with optic disc swelling

rule_out.why: it typically presents with a pale optic disc

trace.fact: Peripapillary retinal hemorrhages and occlusion of the superior branch artery

rule_in.why: it is most directly associated with retinal artery occlusion

rule_out.why: it lacks retinal artery occlusion findings

trace.fact: Combined occlusion of the central retinal artery and vein

rule_in.why: it directly involves both the central retinal artery and vein

rule_out.why: it typically does not involve both artery and vein

trace.fact: Patient is a woman in her 40s

rule_in.why: it is more common in women over 50 but can start in the 40s

trace.fact: Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab

rule_in.why: it is undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab

rule_out.why: treatment with systemic steroids is often used for Giant Cell Arteritis, making it less likely given the context

rule_in.why: normal visual acuity is a routine finding

rule_out.why: it typically presents with severe vision loss

trace.fact: Right eye showed full visual field and relative afferent pupillary defect

rule_in.why: relative afferent pupillary defect suggests optic nerve dysfunction

rule_out.why: full visual field is not typical
